The 3-pillar program chain

Beyond the demos: the real program builds one repo per pillar. The chain is connected when a synthetic-substrate-detected case flows into casework and comes out a verified, signed SAR. The state below is regenerated by scripts/e2e_chain_check.py — not a claim, a check.

Pillar 1 · substrate→persist→ Pillar 2 · casework→signed SAR→human gate
    All data & outputs are illustrative / synthetic — never real customer or transaction data. Offline, self-contained, no network. The cross-pillar chain state is a measured check, not a performance claim.
